messages.content: Got an email that my Bluecrest flight to Denver on Oct 24 moved from 9:10am to 1:45pm. Booking HT-4QX7LM. That wrecks my 2pm meeting. What are my options? - Paula Brennan

Hi Paula, Bluecrest moved your departure by more than 2 hours, so our schedule change policy covers you and nothing extra is owed. Two options:
1. Free rebooking onto another Bluecrest flight within 3 days of your date, no fare difference. The 6:05am on Oct 24 lands in Denver at 8:20am.
2. Travel credit worth 110% of your ticket: $418 on your $380 fare, valid 12 months.
A full refund to your card is also possible if you'd rather not go. Which do you prefer? Please decide within 7 days of the notice, or the new time is auto-accepted.
can i hold the fare to lisbon while i check with my wife? its $642 per person on Aurelian Air for march 14. dont want it to go up

Yes, you can. Two ways to lock it in:
1. 24-hour hold, free: I hold both seats at $642 each ($1,284 total) until this time tomorrow. If you don't book by then, the seats are released and the fare is re-quoted.
2. Book now: since March 14 is more than 7 days away, you can still cancel for a full refund within 24 hours of purchase.
Which would you like? If it's the hold, I just need the traveler names as they appear on your passports.
My travel credit dissapeared!! Trip Wallet says $0.00 but I had $310 from cancelling my Meridia trip in August. Please tell me it's not gone

It's not gone. I can see your credit TC-4418 for $310, valid until August next year. The $0.00 is a known display bug in version 6.3 of the Halcyon Trips app. Two options:
1. Update the app to 6.4 and log in again; the balance shows correctly there.
2. Tell me which trip you want to book and I'll apply the $310 for you from here.
Which works better for you?
Hi, my e-ticket says JONATHON KESSLER but my passport is JONATHAN. Flying Northwake Air tomorrow at 7am, booking HT-9ZB2RT. Am I going to be refused at check-in??

Hi Jonathan, you'll be fine. That's a one-letter difference, and typos of up to 3 characters are corrected for free. Because you fly within 72 hours, I've marked this urgent and filed the correction with Northwake Air now. You can get the corrected e-ticket in two ways:
1. In the Halcyon Trips app under Trips, usually within 2 hours.
2. By email to the address on the booking.
Which would you like? Keep this message handy at check-in just in case.
I need to move booking HT-8LW3QD from Nov 3 to Nov 5. I didn't buy FlexFare. How much will it cost me?

Without FlexFare the change is a $75 fee per traveler plus any fare difference. For Nov 5 I have two options:
1. 9:40am departure: the fare is $48 higher, so $123 in total.
2. 6:15pm departure: same fare as you paid, so just the $75 fee.
Which one should I book for you?
We bought Protect Plus with our Cancún package (HT-3RF6NA, $3,200). Departure is Nov 10. Honestly we just don't want to go anymore. Is there anything we can get back?

Yes, Protect Plus includes Cancel For Any Reason, so you don't need a reason. Your trip is 30 days out, which puts the package in the 15–44 day window with a 50% cancellation fee ($1,600). Two options:
1. Cancel now: $1,600 is refunded under the package terms, and a Cancel For Any Reason claim pays 75% of the $1,600 fee in cash ($1,200). Net cost to you: $400.
2. Wait if there's any chance you'll still travel: the 50% fee stays the same until 15 days before departure, and Cancel For Any Reason works until 48 hours before departure.
Which would you prefer?
Stuck in Halifax. First flight (Solenne) was 3 hrs late, missed my Northwake connection to Glasgow. Booked through you as Halcyon Connect. Do I need to buy a new ticket?? Booking HT-6PJ4WE

Please don't buy anything. Your trip is Halcyon Connect, so we cover the missed connection. Two options:
1. A free seat on tomorrow's 7:25am Northwake flight to Glasgow, plus a hotel tonight paid up to $180.
2. A free seat tonight on Northwake via Dublin, leaving at 10:10pm and landing in Glasgow at 11:40am.
Which do you prefer? If it's the hotel, I'll send the booking to your phone as soon as you confirm.
Need to cancel Calloway Suites in Denver, 4 nights from Nov 20. It's the Saver rate, $189 a night. Can I get anything back

Yes. Saver rates are prepaid and non-refundable, but because check-in is more than 7 days away you get travel credit minus one night. Two options:
1. Cancel now: $567 travel credit ($756 minus one night of $189), valid 12 months.
2. If your plans might still work out, you can wait until Nov 13 and get the same $567. After that, no credit is possible.
Which do you prefer?
Hello. I cancelled booking HT-5KD8YM within 24 hrs 5 days ago and still no refund on my card. How long does this take?

Hello, your cancellation was approved and the $468 refund is on its way. Card refunds take 7–10 business days, so you've had 5 so far. Two options:
1. Keep the card refund: it should arrive by Oct 21 at the latest.
2. Take it as travel credit instead: $468 in your Trip Wallet within 1 hour, valid 12 months.
Which would you like?
is the Voyager membership worth it? i fly maybe 6 times a year and almost always end up changing dates

With 6 trips and frequent changes, a membership likely pays for itself. Two options:
1. Voyager, $79/year: FlexFare Basic is included on every flight, which is one free change per trip (you pay any fare difference). On 6 trips that's $174 of FlexFare for $79.
2. Concierge, $249/year: FlexFare Plus is included (unlimited changes up to 3 hours before departure), plus a dedicated care agent and 2 lounge passes. That's $354 of FlexFare on 6 trips.
If you usually change only once per trip, Voyager is the better deal. Which sounds more like you?
At the gate in Denver, Aurelian says the flight is oversold and I've been bumped. HT-2MV9KC. I have to be in Seattle tonight!

I'm sorry, I'm on it now on the Urgent Travel line. I've checked Aurelian's flights to Seattle tonight and can do two things:
1. Confirmed seat on Aurelian's 4:50pm, landing at 6:35pm. The gate agent must also give you the airline's denied-boarding compensation, so ask them for it.
2. Seat on the 7:30pm with an aisle seat in the exit row, landing at 9:15pm.
Which one do you want? I'll confirm it with Aurelian as soon as you reply.
My Meridia flight was delayed 9 hours, ended up eating 2 meals at the airport and missing a night at my hotel. I have Protect Essential. Can I claim something?

Yes. Protect Essential pays $150 per day for delays of more than 6 hours, so your 9-hour delay qualifies for $150. A prepaid hotel night you missed can be included if the hotel didn't refund it. Two options:
1. File it yourself in the app (Trips > Protect > File claim) with your meal receipts and Meridia's delay confirmation.
2. Send me those documents and I'll file it for you.
Either way, you'll get a PC- claim number and a decision within 10 business days of complete documents. Claims must be filed within 30 days after your trip ends. Which do you prefer?
Meridia changed our return to land in Providence instead of Boston. Our car is parked in Boston. Booking HT-7TN2GX, 3 travelers.

A change of airport counts as a schedule change, so all three of you are covered. Two options:
1. Free rebooking back into Boston on another Meridia flight within 3 days of your date, no fare difference. The 3:20pm on the same day lands in Boston at 5:05pm.
2. Travel credit worth 110% of the tickets: $1,353 on the $1,230 you paid, valid 12 months.
A full refund is also available. Which do you prefer? Please reply within 7 days of the notice, or the Providence arrival is auto-accepted.
why did you charge my card $2,940 today?? booking HT-1CH5VB banff

That's the balance for your Banff package (flight plus 5 nights at Alder & Pine Lodge). Package balances are charged automatically 45 days before departure, and your deposit of $400 for two travelers was already paid. If something has changed, you have two options:
1. Keep the trip: no action needed. Everything is confirmed and your documents are in the app.
2. Cancel today, while you're still 45 days out: the $2,940 is refunded and your $400 deposit becomes travel credit.
Which do you prefer? After today, the 50% cancellation fee applies.
I booked the wrong date yesterday night (Oct 16 instead of Oct 19), flight is in 5 days. Can I cancel for free? HT-4YR7SL, Bluecrest, $286

Your departure is less than 7 days away, so the free 24-hour cancellation doesn't apply. You booked less than 24 hours ago, though, so there's a cheaper fix. Two options:
1. Add FlexFare Basic now for $29 and move to Oct 19. The Oct 19 fare is the same, so you pay $29 in total.
2. Cancel for travel credit: $211 ($286 minus the $75 fee), valid 12 months.
Which do you prefer? Option 1 is only possible until 24 hours after your booking time, so please reply soon.
I have FlexFare Plus on HT-6MQ3ZD (Solenne Air, $512). Work trip got cancelled, flight is Thursday. What happens if I cancel?

Good news: FlexFare Plus lets you cancel up to 3 hours before departure for 100% travel credit. Two options:
1. Cancel now: $512 travel credit in your Trip Wallet within 1 hour, valid 12 months.
2. If the trip might be rescheduled, keep the booking and move it later. Changes are unlimited with FlexFare Plus, and if the new fare is lower you get the difference back as credit.
Which do you prefer?
Booked a Northwake flight last week without FlexFare. Can I add it now? My plans are a bit up in the air

FlexFare can only be added at booking or within 24 hours of booking, so this flight can't get it anymore. Two options:
1. Keep the booking as it is. If you need to change it, it's $75 plus any fare difference, and if you cancel you get travel credit of the fare minus $75.
2. For future trips, Voyager membership ($79/year) includes FlexFare Basic on every flight booking.
Would you like me to price a change now, or tell you more about Voyager?
pls cancel my room at Harbor Lantern Hotel Lisbon, check-in is thursday. booking HT-8VA2KU. its the flexible rate i think

It is the StayPlus Flexible rate, so you can cancel for free until 48 hours before check-in (15:00 Lisbon time on Tuesday). Two options:
1. Cancel now, free. Nothing is charged since you pay at the hotel.
2. If you still need Lisbon later, I can move the stay to new dates at the same Flexible rate, if it's available.
Which would you like?
My $640 travel credit expires next Friday but I can't travel until April. Can you extend it? HCA-3307

Yes. You're asking before it expires, so you qualify for the one-time 6-month extension. Two options:
1. Extend the credit: I'll send it to Rosalind Pike's Refunds & Credits team today, and the new expiry date will show in your Trip Wallet within 3 business days.
2. Use it now: book your April trip before Friday and apply the $640. The credit only has to be used at booking, not for travel.
Which do you prefer?
my credit expired 2 weeks ago, i completely forgot. $220. can i still use it, please?

I'm sorry, an expired credit can't be extended. The 6-month extension is only possible if it's requested before the expiry date. I'd still like to help, so here are two options:
1. A $150 goodwill credit on your next booking, which I can add today.
2. I can ask our Refunds & Credits lead to review your case for a larger goodwill amount. That takes up to 3 business days and isn't guaranteed.
Which would you prefer?
Can I pay for Halcyon Protect with my travel credit? I have $300 left on TC-2290

Travel credit can't be used for Halcyon Protect or FlexFare, only for flights, StayPlus hotels and packages. Two options for your trip:
1. Put the $300 credit on the flight and pay for Protect Essential (5% of the trip cost, $46 here) by card.
2. Pay for the flight with the credit and skip Protect for now. Essential can be added any time before departure.
Which works for you?
Bluecrest moved my flight 45 minutes earlier, now leaves at 6:15am. Can I switch to the later one at 11:30? HT-3BX9FE

Since the change is under 2 hours, it doesn't qualify for free rebooking, but the change fee is waived as a schedule-change courtesy. Two options:
1. Accept the 6:15am departure at no cost.
2. Switch to the 11:30am: you only pay the $36 fare difference, with no $75 fee.
Which do you prefer? Please decide within 7 days of the notice.
The app won't let me hold another fare. I already have 3 on hold, it's for my team's offsite and we're comparing dates

That's the limit: each account can have 3 active 24-hour holds. Two options:
1. Release one of your current holds (Trips > Holds > Release), and then the new fare can be held.
2. Book one of the options now. If departure is at least 7 days away, you can cancel for a full refund within 24 hours of purchase.
Which option works better for your team?
My hold expired last night and now the Meridia fare to Austin went from $219 to $264. Can you give me the old price?

I'm sorry, a 24-hour hold can't be extended or reinstated. When it lapses, the seats are released and the fare is re-quoted. Here's what I can offer:
1. Book the same flight now at $264.
2. Fly the next day, Nov 8, on the 8:45am Meridia flight for $221, close to your original price.
Which do you prefer? I can also hold either one for you for another 24 hours.
Family emergency, my mom is in hospital. We need to cancel our Marisol Bay package HT-2QK6RM, leaving in 10 days. We have Protect Essential. Please help

I'm so sorry about your mother. Here's how we can protect your money. With less than 15 days to go, the package itself is non-refundable, but a family member's illness is a covered reason under Protect Essential. Two options:
1. Cancel now and file a Protect claim with a doctor's note about your mother's hospitalization. You'd be reimbursed for the non-refundable package cost once approved.
2. If her situation might improve, wait a few days. The package terms won't change before departure, but please file your claim within 30 days after the original trip end date.
Which would you prefer? I can file the claim with Tomasz Vrba's team for you.
Bluecrest lost my suitcase on the way to Lisbon, it's been 3 days. I have Protect Plus. what do I do

I'm sorry you're without your bag. Protect Plus covers baggage up to $2,500. First, make sure you have Bluecrest's lost-baggage report number. Then you have two options:
1. File the claim yourself in the app (Trips > Protect > File claim), adding the Bluecrest report and receipts for anything you had to buy.
2. Send those documents to me and I'll file it for you today.
You'll get a PC- claim number and a decision within 10 business days of complete documents. Which do you prefer?
Concierge member here (HCA-1182). Northwake just CANCELLED my 4pm to Montreal. I need to be there tonight.

I'm on it. An airline cancellation is a schedule change, so changing your flight is free. Two options:
1. Free rebooking on Northwake's 6:40pm tonight, landing in Montreal at 8:05pm. I'm holding a seat for you now.
2. A full refund to your card, if you'd rather drive or take the train.
Which do you prefer? Your dedicated care agent will follow up on the details.
My friend Sam can't come on our trip anymore. Can I just put my sister's name on his ticket? HT-5WH8NP

I'm sorry, tickets can't be moved to another person. Only small typo corrections of up to 3 characters are allowed. Two options:
1. Cancel Sam's ticket for travel credit of the fare minus $75 ($289 on his $364 fare), and book a new seat for your sister. If she's on your Halcyon account, the credit can go toward her ticket.
2. Keep Sam's ticket, and change its date later if he can travel then ($75 fee plus fare difference).
Which would you like to do?
I booked on the website but the trip isn't showing up in the Halcyon Trips app. Do I need to rebook??

No need to rebook, your booking is confirmed. Two ways to get it into the app:
1. In the app, tap Trips > Add booking and enter your HT- booking reference and the lead traveler's surname.
2. Tell me the email address you use in the app, and I'll link the booking to that account from here.
Which do you prefer? Once it's linked, your boarding passes will be saved offline too.
hi, flying to Banff in late December with Protect Essential. I'd like to upgrade to Protect Plus for the cancel for any reason thing. Booked 3 weeks ago.

Protect Plus has to be bought within 14 days of the first booking payment, and your booking is 3 weeks old, so I can't upgrade it. Two options:
1. Keep Protect Essential. It covers cancellation for covered reasons like illness, injury or severe weather, and trip delays.
2. If you might cancel for another reason, do it before the balance is charged 45 days before departure. Then your deposit becomes travel credit and nothing else is lost.
Would you like me to send you the full Essential coverage summary?
The fare on my Aurelian flight dropped $60 since I booked. I have FlexFare Plus. Do I get anything? HT-9RC4TU

Yes. With FlexFare Plus, if you change to a lower fare, the difference comes back as travel credit. Two options:
1. Rebook the same flight at the new price: $60 travel credit in your Trip Wallet within 1 hour, with no change fee.
2. Keep the booking as it is and wait. Your unlimited changes stay available until 3 hours before departure, in case the fare drops further.
Which do you prefer?
How much do we pay upfront to reserve a Cancún package for 4 people? Flight + Marisol Bay, leaving in March.

For a package you pay a deposit of $200 per traveler now, so $800 for four. The balance is charged automatically 45 days before departure. Packages can't be put on a 24-hour hold, so you have two options:
1. Pay the $800 deposit now, and the balance is charged in late January.
2. Pay the full amount now. The cancellation terms are the same either way.
Which do you prefer? I can also add Halcyon Protect Plus if you'd like the Cancel For Any Reason cover, as long as you buy it within 14 days of paying.
We're a 5-person design studio. Can all of us use one shared pot of travel credit for conference trips? Account HCA-4120.

Yes, as long as all five people are travelers on your HCA-4120 account, since credit can only be used by travelers on the same account. Two options:
1. Add the four colleagues to HCA-4120 as travelers, and any of them can use the account's credits.
2. Keep separate accounts, and each person's credit stays with them.
One limit: a single booking can use at most 3 credits. Which setup do you prefer?
I overslept and missed my 7am Bluecrest flight to Chicago. My fault I know. HT-3NE8JW, no flexfare. What now

Don't worry, let's get you on the next flight. Without FlexFare, a change costs $75 plus any fare difference. Two options:
1. The 11:20am today: fare difference $94, so $169 in total.
2. Tomorrow at 7:00am: same fare as you paid, so just the $75 fee.
Which do you prefer? Seats on the 11:20am are going fast, so please reply soon.
Concierge member, how many lounge passes do I have left this year? Flying out of Denver Friday.

Concierge includes 2 lounge passes per year, and you haven't used any yet, so you have both. Two options for Friday:
1. I add one pass to your Friday boarding pass in the app, so you'll have one left for later this year.
2. Add both if you're traveling with a companion.
Which would you like?
there's a hurricane warning near Cancún and we leave in 4 days!! package HT-7GD1KS with Protect Essential. are we covered if we cancel?

I understand the worry. Severe weather is a covered reason under Protect Essential, and airlines often allow free changes during storm warnings. Two options:
1. Wait 24–48 hours for the forecast. If your airline changes or cancels the flight, the schedule change rules apply (free rebooking or a full refund).
2. Cancel now and file a Protect claim. Your package is within 15 days of departure, so it's non-refundable, and Protect Essential would reimburse it once the claim is approved with the weather warning attached.
Which do you prefer? I'm keeping an eye on your flights either way.
My Northwake flight was delayed 5 and a half hours yesterday. I have Protect Essential, can I claim the delay money?

I'm sorry about the long wait. Protect Essential pays the trip-delay benefit only for delays of more than 6 hours, so a 5.5-hour delay doesn't qualify. Two options:
1. Ask Northwake for its own delay compensation or meal reimbursement. I can send you the link to their claim form.
2. I can add a $50 goodwill travel credit to your account for the trouble.
Which would you like?
Can you guarantee connecting rooms at Marisol Bay Resort? Traveling with 2 small kids. Booking HT-4LP7HA

I can pass the request on, but StayPlus hotels never guarantee connecting rooms. Two options:
1. Keep your 2 rooms and I'll add a connecting-room request with a note about the kids. The resort decides at check-in.
2. Switch to a Two-Bedroom Family Suite, which keeps everyone together for sure, for $85 more per night.
Which do you prefer?
I got a schedule change email like 10 days ago and didn't do anything. Now I want my money back since the new time doesn't work. HT-2SV6CB

I'm sorry. You have 7 days to respond to a schedule change notice, and after that the new schedule is auto-accepted, so the free options have expired. Here's what's still possible under the standard rules:
1. Change to a better time: $75 plus any fare difference. The 2:10pm has the same fare, so it's $75.
2. Cancel for travel credit: $331 ($406 fare minus $75), valid 12 months.
Which would you like? If you missed the notice for a reason like an email problem, tell me and I'll ask Desmond Achterberg's team to review it.
What time does your support open? I'm in California and it's 5:30am here. Flight is next week.

Our Traveler Care desk is open daily 07:00–23:00 Eastern Time, which is 4:00–20:00 Pacific, so we're open now. Two ways to reach us:
1. In-app chat: Halcyon Trips app > Help > Chat.
2. Phone: 555-0163.
From 72 hours before departure you can also use the Urgent Travel line, 555-0168, 24/7. Which would you like to use?
Bought Protect Plus 4 days ago for $192 on a $2,400 trip. Changed my mind, it's too much. Refund?

Yes. Every Protect policy has a 10-day free look, so you get the full premium back. Two options:
1. Cancel Protect Plus: $192 back to your card within 7–10 business days.
2. Switch to Protect Essential at 5% ($120): you get the $192 back and pay $120 for Essential. That keeps cover for illness, injury, delays and baggage, but not Cancel For Any Reason.
Which do you prefer?
I filed claim PC-3318 two weeks ago and heard nothing. Its for my lost bag in Denver.

I checked PC-3318 for you. The decision comes within 10 business days of complete documents, and your claim is still missing the receipt for the replacement items. Two options:
1. Upload the receipt in the app: Trips > Protect > PC-3318 > Add documents.
2. Email it to halcyon.care@example.com with PC-3318 in the subject, and I'll attach it.
The 10-day clock starts once it's in. Which is easier for you?
I pay for Voyager so I'm supposed to get faster answers. I waited 10 hours for a reply yesterday. Not great.

You're right, and I'm sorry. As a Voyager member you should get a first reply within 6 hours, and we missed that. Two options to make it right:
1. A $40 goodwill travel credit, added today.
2. A free month added to your Voyager membership.
Which would you prefer? I've also flagged the delay to Nadia Okafor-Hale, who leads our Club team.
Can I book a StayPlus hotel and a flight separately and still get the package deal?

Package pricing only applies when the flight and the StayPlus hotel are booked together as one package. Two options:
1. Book as a package: usually cheaper, with a $200 deposit per traveler and the balance due 45 days before departure.
2. Book them separately: you can put the flight on a 24-hour hold and choose a StayPlus Flexible rate with free cancellation until 48 hours before check-in.
If you tell me the dates and destination, I'll compare both prices. Which would you like to see?
Is my trip to Lisbon still on? The app shows a red banner on my Aurelian flight. HT-6KT3MB

Your trip is still on. The red banner means Aurelian changed your schedule: your outbound now leaves 2h 40m later, at 9:55pm. Since that's more than 2 hours, you can choose:
1. Free rebooking onto another Aurelian flight within 3 days of your date, no fare difference. There's a 6:30pm the same evening.
2. Travel credit worth 110% of your ticket: $781 on your $710 fare, or a full refund if you'd rather cancel.
Which do you prefer? You can also choose in the app under Trips > Review change within 7 days.
I'm a Voyager member and already moved my Denver flight once. Now I need to move it again, ugh. HT-8QF2DN

No problem, let's sort it out. Your Voyager membership includes FlexFare Basic, which covers one free change per trip, and you've used it. A second change is $75 plus any fare difference. Two options:
1. Move to Saturday at 10:15am: same fare, so $75.
2. Move to Sunday at 4:40pm: $22 cheaper, but the $75 fee still applies, so $75 and no credit back.
Which do you prefer? For trips with frequent changes, Concierge includes FlexFare Plus with unlimited changes.
we need to cancel our Banff package, HT-5MR9AE. 3 travelers, $4,050 total, leaving mid December

Your departure is more than 45 days away, so this is the most flexible point to cancel. Two options:
1. Cancel now: your $600 deposit ($200 x 3) becomes travel credit, valid 12 months, and the remaining $3,450 is refunded to your card within 7–10 business days.
2. If you're unsure, wait. The terms stay the same until the balance is charged 45 days before departure. After that, a 50% fee applies.
Which would you like?
Need to cancel our Lisbon package, 3 weeks out. $2,600. No insurance. How bad is it?

At 3 weeks out you're in the 15–44 day window, so the cancellation fee is 50% of the package price ($1,300). Two options:
1. Cancel now: $1,300 refunded to your card within 7–10 business days.
2. Take the $1,300 as travel credit instead, and I'll add a $100 goodwill credit, so $1,400 in total, valid 12 months.
Please decide soon: from 15 days before departure, the package is non-refundable. Which do you prefer?
I have 4 small travel credits ($60, $85, $120, $150). Can I use all of them on one booking for Solenne to Miami ($389)?

A single booking can use at most 3 credits, so here are two ways to get the most out of them:
1. Use the three largest ($150 + $120 + $85 = $355) and pay $34 by card. The $60 credit stays in your Trip Wallet.
2. Split it: use all four credits across two bookings, for example your outbound and return booked separately.
Which do you prefer?
Halcyon Connect trip, first flight was late and I missed the connection in Charlotte. Nobody answered chat so I bought a new Meridia ticket for $340. Will you pay me back?

I'm sorry you were left on your own. Normally travelers call the Urgent Travel line (555-0168) before buying anything, so we can't promise to cover the full ticket automatically. Here's what I can do:
1. Refund your unused Halcyon Connect segment right away: $128 back to your card.
2. Do that, and also ask a lead to approve a goodwill credit for the rest of the $340. I'll send it today with your Meridia receipt.
Which would you like? If it's option 2, please reply with the receipt.
Can I put the Marisol Bay package on hold for a day while my partner checks her leave?

Packages can't be put on a 24-hour hold, but you can still protect the price. Two options:
1. Hold just the flights for 24 hours, free, at today's fare, and book Marisol Bay at the StayPlus Flexible rate, which is free to cancel until 48 hours before check-in.
2. Book the package now with the $200 per traveler deposit. If you cancel 45 or more days before departure, the deposit becomes travel credit.
Which do you prefer?
My ticket says WOJCIK but my passport says WOJCIECHOWSKA. Booked 2 days ago, Northwake, $412. Can you fix the name?

I'm sorry for the trouble. We can only correct typos of up to 3 characters, and this difference is bigger, so the ticket has to be cancelled and rebooked. Two options:
1. Cancel for $337 travel credit ($412 minus $75) and rebook the same flight under WOJCIECHOWSKA for $398. You pay $61.
2. Rebook the 3:05pm the same day for $352, which the credit covers almost fully. You pay $15.
Which would you like? I'll check that the new ticket matches your passport exactly.
i have FlexFare Basic, can i change my destination from Austin to Nashville instead?

FlexFare Basic covers one date or time change, not a new destination. Here are two options:
1. Cancel the Austin ticket for $258 travel credit ($333 minus $75) and book Nashville for $289. You pay $31.
2. Keep Austin, and save your free FlexFare Basic change for a date or time change.
Which do you prefer?
How much of my travel credit is left and when does it expire? TC-3051

TC-3051 started at $500, and $320 was used on your Bluecrest booking in June, so $180 is left. It expires in March next year, 12 months from when it was issued. Two ways to use it:
1. On a flight or a StayPlus hotel: it applies at checkout automatically from your Trip Wallet.
2. Keep it. If you can't travel before March, ask us before it expires and you can get a one-time 6-month extension.
Would you like me to look for something now?
I was charged twice for HT-1JK8WZ, $458 each. My bank shows both.

I'm sorry about that. I can see one booking for $458 and a second charge from a payment that was retried. The duplicate is now being reversed. Two options:
1. Refund the $458 duplicate to your card: it takes 7–10 business days.
2. Take it as travel credit instead: $458 in your Trip Wallet within 1 hour.
Which do you prefer?
need to cancel Calloway Suites, check-in is TOMORROW. flexible rate, 3 nights at $212

Flexible rates are free to cancel until 48 hours before check-in, and we're past that now, so the hotel charges the first night. Two options:

What's our first-response SLA on urgent tickets?

Urgent means departing within 72 hours or already traveling. First response within 1 hour, 24/7. Concierge members get 15 minutes. Standard tickets are 12 hours (6 hours for Voyager), and refund or claim tickets are 3 business days.
Who approves a travel credit extension, and when is it allowed?

Rosalind Pike's Refunds & Credits team approves them. It's a one-time 6-month extension, and only if the traveler asks before the credit expires. Expired credits can't be extended, though you can offer goodwill within your limit.

Up to $150 per booking on your own. Up to $400 with a lead's approval. Anything above $400 needs Mireille Fontaine, Head of Traveler Care.
Quick one: which schedule changes get the free rebooking / refund / 110% credit options?

A change of 2 hours or more to departure or arrival, a new connection, or a different airport. The traveler then picks free rebooking on the same airline within ±3 days with no fare difference, a full refund, or 110% travel credit. Under 2 hours, they accept it or move flights paying only the fare difference, with the $75 fee waived.
How long does a traveler have to respond to a schedule change before it locks in?

7 days from the notice. They respond in the app under Trips > Review change, or through us. After 7 days the new schedule is auto-accepted, and normal change rules apply. Desmond Achterberg's Schedule Change desk handles exceptions.
Remind me of the FlexFare tiers and prices?

Both are per traveler, per trip, and can only be added at booking or within 24 hours of booking. FlexFare Basic is $29: one date/time change with no change fee, and the traveler pays any fare difference. FlexFare Plus is $59: unlimited changes up to 3 hours before departure, a lower fare comes back as travel credit, and cancelling up to 3 hours out gives 100% travel credit. Without FlexFare, it's $75 per traveler plus the fare difference.
Customer wants to pay for Halcyon Protect with travel credit. Allowed?
No. Travel credit works on flights, StayPlus hotels and packages only, not on Halcyon Protect or FlexFare. They can put the credit on the trip and pay for Protect by card.

No. Protect Plus has to be bought within 14 days of the first booking payment. Protect Essential can be added any time before departure, so offer that instead. Remember that Essential doesn't include Cancel For Any Reason.
What's the free-look period on Halcyon Protect?
10 days. If the traveler cancels the policy within 10 days of buying it and before the trip starts, they get the full premium back to the original payment method.
Package cancellation terms, please. I always mix up the windows.

The deposit is $200 per traveler, and the balance is charged automatically 45 days before departure. Cancelling 45+ days out: the deposit becomes travel credit and the rest is refunded. 15–44 days out: a 50% fee on the package price. Under 15 days: non-refundable, though Halcyon Protect may reimburse if the reason is covered.
Traveler on a Halcyon Connect itinerary missed their connection because the first flight was late. What do we cover?

Yes, 3 active holds per account. Each hold is free and lasts exactly 24 hours, and it can't be extended. When it lapses, the seats are released and the fare is re-quoted. Holds are only for flights: packages and StayPlus hotels can't be held.
Who picks up the Urgent Travel line overnight?

The Westgate care center covers 23:00–07:00 ET. During the day it's the Harborview care center, which also runs the Traveler Care desk (07:00–23:00 ET, 555-0163). The Urgent Travel line is 555-0168, 24/7.
Traveler's ticket has their surname misspelled by 2 letters. Is there a fee?

Yes, it's a known bug in Halcyon Trips 6.3: Trip Wallet shows $0.00 after login. No credit is lost. Ask them to update to 6.4, which fixes it, or apply the credit to their booking yourself.

Saver is prepaid and non-refundable. If they cancel more than 7 days before check-in, they get travel credit for the stay minus one night. Within 7 days, there's no credit. Voyager costs $79 a year: FlexFare Basic on every flight booking, and a 6-hour standard SLA. Concierge costs $249 a year: FlexFare Plus on every flight, a dedicated care agent, a 15-minute urgent SLA and 2 airport lounge passes per year. Explorer is free and has the standard SLAs. Nadia Okafor-Hale leads the Club team.

Travelers file within 30 days after the trip ends, in the app under Trips > Protect > File claim, and get a PC- claim number. The decision comes within 10 business days of complete documents. Tomasz Vrba is our liaison with Wexmoor Assurance for stuck claims.
Can a traveler stack multiple travel credits on one booking?
Yes, up to 3 credits per booking, and only travelers on the same Halcyon account can use them. Each credit keeps its own 12-month expiry.
How fast do refunds and credits actually land?

Travel credit appears in the Trip Wallet within 1 hour. Refunds to the original payment method take 7–10 business days. If a traveler is worried about timing, you can offer to convert a pending refund to instant travel credit.
